يقطوطي (form XII)
# يَقْطَوْطِي (yaqṭawṭī) /jaq.tˤaw.tˤiː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
# يَقْطَوْطِيَ (yaqṭawṭiya) /jaq.tˤaw.tˤi.ja/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْطَوْطَى (iqṭawṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
